propositions: Test test_five_environment_matrix_has_identical_results_without_gh fails on macOS dev hosts with ambient GIT_CONFIG_* env vars (safe.bareRepository=explicit) but passes in CI due to inherited os.environ in git() and bare_git() helpers.

Bridge harness helpers git()/bare_git() in test_run_reconcile_bridge.py inherit os.environ wholesale, allowing command-scope git-config injection to reach bare repository verification calls and cause 'fatal: cannot use bare repository' errors.
The same ambient GIT_CONFIG_* injection breaks 21 tests across test_run_reconcile_bridge_heldout.py and test_bridge_runner_install_paths_heldout.py on dev hosts with agent harnesses.
Unsetting GIT_CONFIG_COUNT/KEY_*/VALUE_* env vars locally flips all 5 matrix params from FAIL to PASS, proving the root cause is environment variable inheritance, not gh itself.

The fix must scrub command-scope git-config injection from harness helpers and runner_env(), pin GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1, and monkeypatch the hostile injection into the matrix test to make the regression deterministic in CI.
